name: Intetra Teknoloji ve Bilisim Hizmetleri AS
summary: Intetra Teknoloji ve Bilisim Hizmetleri AS engages in the development of projects in the fields of intelligent transportation systems, electronic toll collection solutions, traffic and mobility management, artificial intelligence-supported platforms, and smart city technologies. The company was founded by Mehmet Ömerbeyoglu in 2005 and is headquartered in Tuzla, Turkey.
